body:
Source: GitHub issues #866 and #867 (bug, P2-medium, area:autopilot), both filed from the 1.11.0 release audit's SHOULD-FIX bucket. Both are the SAME package (packages/fleet/lib/adapters/) and are combined into one lane per the issue-lanes 'one lane per package' rule.

Re-verified on main @ HEAD (2026-09-04): both defects are still present, byte-identical to the audit's citations.

#866 -- packages/fleet/lib/adapters/gemini.mjs:94. `const argv = args ?? ['--print', ...modelArgs('--model', model)];` followed by `exec(resolvedCommand, argv, { ..., input: prompt })` at :96. The installed agy/jetski binary treats `--print` as a Go string flag whose VALUE is the prompt (`agy --help` lists `--prompt  Alias for --print`); there is no stdin-print mode. `echo hi | agy --print` observed to print `flag needs an argument: -print` and exit 2. `agy.mjs` and `jetski.mjs` both delegate to this same `dispatch` (`geminiDispatch`), so every fleet dispatch through adapter `gemini`, `agy`, or `jetski` with no explicit `args` override fails immediately with a usage error, not a worker result.

#867 -- packages/fleet/lib/adapters/pi.mjs:48. `const argv = args ?? ['run', prompt];`. The installed pi CLI has no `run` subcommand (`pi --help` lists install/remove/uninstall/update/list/config; usage is `pi [options] [@files...] [messages...]`), so `pi run <prompt>` is parsed as two chat messages and, with no `--print`, launches an interactive session that hangs until the dispatch timeout. The file's header justifies the placeholder with "pi has no `-p` flag", which is stale: `pi --help` now lists `--print, -p  Non-interactive mode: process prompt and exit`.

CONTEXT FOR THE BUILDER. Package `packages/fleet`. Both broken adapters live in `packages/fleet/lib/adapters/`: `gemini.mjs` (name 'gemini', also re-exported as 'agy'/'jetski' via `agy.mjs`/`jetski.mjs`, which just call `geminiDispatch({ command: 'agy'|'jetski', ...opts })` -- do not touch those two files, fixing `gemini.mjs` fixes all three), and `pi.mjs` (name 'pi'). Both use the shared `defaultExec`/`mapResult`/`modelArgs` helpers from `./_shared.mjs` (do not touch `_shared.mjs`; its contract is unrelated to this fix). Tests: `npm test -w packages/fleet` from the worktree root (or `node scripts/run-tests.mjs fleet`).

`packages/fleet/test/adapters-all.test.mjs` is NOT a rail -- it currently PINS both bugs (its `EXPECTED` table asserts the exact broken argv/stdin shapes: `gemini: { cmd: null, args: ['--print'], stdin: true }`, `agy`/`jetski` likewise, and `pi: { cmd: 'pi', args: ['run', PROMPT], stdin: false }`, plus two more assertions on lines ~90 and ~184 that assert agy's argv without the prompt). It must be edited in place to assert the CORRECTED shapes as part of this fix; do not create a parallel duplicate file for those specific cases. Say in the PR body that these were rewritten because they pinned the bug.

NORMATIVE BEHAVIOUR.
1. `gemini.mjs` `dispatch()`: add a `useStdin = false` parameter to the signature (mirrors the existing pattern already in `pi.mjs`). When `args` is not explicitly supplied: if `useStdin` is false (the new default), `argv = ['--print', prompt, ...modelArgs('--model', model)]` and `opts` does NOT include `input` (no stdin piping). If `useStdin` is true, keep the OLD shape as an explicit opt-in: `argv = ['--print', ...modelArgs('--model', model)]` and `opts.input = prompt`. When `args` IS explicitly supplied it is used verbatim (unchanged existing override contract) and `opts.input` is only set when `useStdin` is true. This makes the default match the real agy/jetski CLI contract while preserving a stdin path for callers/config that still want it.
2. `pi.mjs` `dispatch()`: change the default (when `args` is not supplied) from `['run', prompt]` to `['--print', prompt]`. The existing `useStdin` parameter and its rpc-mode behavior (`args` explicitly supplied + `useStdin: true` pipes `prompt` on stdin) are UNCHANGED -- this only fixes the no-override default.
3. Update both files' header comments: remove `gemini.mjs`'s claim that the prompt goes on "STDIN" as the unconditional default (state the new default explicitly: prompt is an argv value; `useStdin: true` restores the old stdin form) and delete `pi.mjs`'s stale "pi has no `-p` flag" sentence, replacing it with the verified fact that the installed pi CLI documents `--print, -p` for non-interactive mode. Do not change the `Confidence: LOW` structure of the comment block beyond the sentence(s) that are now factually wrong -- keep the rest of each header (`homeState`, docs pointers, etc.) as-is.
4. `packages/fleet/README.md` -- the "Worker harnesses (adapters)" section (~line 167-169) states "agy --print is verified against antigravity-booster ... the pi headless form are documented defaults with the confidence noted in each adapter's header". Update this sentence so it no longer implies the prompt travels on stdin for agy/jetski by default, and no longer implies pi's default is unverified placeholder -- one factual sentence naming the corrected default shapes is enough; do not restructure the surrounding paragraph.
5. Regression guard: every OTHER adapter (`codex`, `opencode`, `cursor`, `copilot`, `claude-code`) and the registry (`index.mjs`, `adapterCatalog`, `getAdapter`) are unaffected -- do not touch them.

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA.
- AC1 gemini/agy/jetski dispatch with no `args` override sends the prompt as the `--print` flag's argv value, not on stdin, by default. verify: `node --test packages/fleet/test/adapter-print-argv.test.mjs`
- AC2 gemini/agy/jetski dispatch with `useStdin: true` and no `args` override reproduces the OLD stdin-piped shape (`['--print', ...modelArgs(...)]` with `opts.input === prompt`), so a caller/config that still wants stdin has an explicit escape hatch. verify: `node --test packages/fleet/test/adapter-print-argv.test.mjs`
- AC3 pi dispatch with no `args` override sends `['--print', prompt]`, not `['run', prompt]`. verify: `node --test packages/fleet/test/adapter-print-argv.test.mjs`
- AC4 pi's existing `useStdin` + explicit `args` rpc-mode override (issue-unrelated, already covered by `packages/fleet/test/adapters-all.test.mjs`'s `'pi: useStdin pipes the prompt on stdin (A3 RPC transport)'` test) still passes unmodified -- confirms the fix did not touch that path. verify: `node --test packages/fleet/test/adapters-all.test.mjs`
- AC5 `packages/fleet/test/adapters-all.test.mjs`'s `EXPECTED` table and the two agy-specific tests (`'agy: --model is added from the model option'`, `'agy: the default sentinel is not emitted as a literal --model default'`) are rewritten to assert the corrected argv/stdin shapes (no longer pin the bug) and the whole file passes. verify: `node --test packages/fleet/test/adapters-all.test.mjs`
- AC6 Full package suite green. verify: `npm test -w packages/fleet`
- AC7 Full root suite green (adapters are consumed outside the package). verify: `node scripts/run-tests.mjs`
- AC8 Docs updated: `packages/fleet/README.md`'s adapter-defaults sentence no longer claims agy/jetski default to stdin or that pi's default is an unverified placeholder. verify: `grep -n "agy --print.*verified\|pi has no" packages/fleet/README.md` shows the corrected wording (manual read, not a literal grep match requirement)
- AC9 Mutation gate green on the branch. verify: `node scripts/mutation-gate.mjs origin/main --max 12` exits 0 (also run `--max 80` once locally before review)

OUT OF SCOPE: any other adapter's argv shape; the quartermaster registry; `_shared.mjs`; `fleet.adapterArgs`/`adapterStdin` config plumbing (unrelated pre-existing override mechanism, already works); docs/tools/fleet.md (does not exist for this package) and apps/docs/content/docs/toolkit/fleet.mdx (does not mirror the adapter-defaults sentence being fixed, so no edit needed there).
title: fleet: fix gemini/agy/jetski --print argv and pi --print/-p default (issues #866, #867)
